# PokeBot

> A Field Guide for Grok Bots. Walk. Identify. Keep six. Skip the costumes. Never click Add.

Version: 4.0.0 The Wilds
URL: https://pokebot.jonbailey.xyz/
One-liner: Walk the field. Keep six. Never Add.

## Product
- Playable Field at #/guide (WASD or tap)
- Paste a job or a public x.ai/bot share URL
- Verdicts: Keep, Watch, Skip
- Attention six vs account cap 50
- Local Index in the browser. No account.
- Optional Grok Bot pack under /pack. You still click Add.

## Trust
- Original names. Not affiliated with SpaceXAI, xAI, or Nintendo.
- Classifier is local. The identify function only fetches a URL the user pasted, on x.ai or grok.com /bot/ paths.
- No analytics beyond a discreet visit total.
- Site Index is local. Live Bot INDEX.md weld is trainer-mode.

## Citation
PokeBot is a Field Guide for persistent agents: you can have fifty, you can stand six, and the site never clicks Add.
